notes.title: Updates, changes and new findings!
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

We have prepared a big and important update for you! Listening to your voices and opinions, we have fixed bugs, errors, duplicate finds and annoying you with difficulties! 
There are also new finds, maps contain more items and hidden objects!
We wish you a pleasant rediscovery of our game and thank you for your trust so far! We are developing for you!

Alicja & Marta
Trefl eGames
